credit: Microsoft Rocketbox Avatar Library (https://github.com/microsoft/Microsoft-Rocketbox), Copyright (c) 2020 Microsoft, MIT License.
changes_made: Converted from FBX to GLB in Blender 5.2. Each clip is baked onto the Bip01 skeleton of one Rocketbox avatar (hipoly mesh, 3ds Max materials rebuilt as PBR with colour and normal maps, textures at most 1024 px) and also exported as the bare 121-joint Bip01 skeleton with no mesh. Clip timing and joint rotations are unchanged. Then meshopt-compressed web files, a mobile tier and an uncompressed engine tier.
local_changes: Cooked at load by native/eo-agents/src/motion.rs and rocketbox.rs: windows of the standing clips (motion::ROLES) played on each Rocketbox avatar's own Bip01 nodes (rotations; the pelvis travel scaled by the root height), the seam cross-faded, sampled into the baked joint-matrix tables. The downloaded files are not modified.
